actions.name: read_file
actions.description: Read the zizmor dist-info INSTALLER file to understand how the audit tool was installed. File contains 'pip', confirming zizmor 1.25.2 was installed via pip into .audit-tools/. Combined with the binary files in .audit-bin/ (actionlint ELF binary and its tarball, plus a .audit-tools/bin/zizmor binary), this indicates the repository recently added a security-auditing toolchain: actionlint (GitHub Actions workflow linter, downloaded as a pre-compiled Linux binary) and zizmor 1.25.2 (another Actions security scanner, installed via pip). These tools are stored locally to enable offline/sandboxed CI security scanning of GitHub Actions workflows without network access at scan time.
